dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello there.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: Hello. I am Lady Ningguang's bodyguard.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: Well, that's my title, anyway. In practice, this is a clerical job roughly half the time.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: I was doing various odd jobs for a while, before being roped back in here to my old post once the Jade Chamber was restored.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Jade Chamber, how may I be of service?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello, who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: I am Lady Ningguang's bodyguard. Traveler, what business brings you here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Ningguang...

dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: Ah, so you're another one of those who wants to find out Lady Ningguang's secrets, are you? Unfortunately, I know no more than you do...

dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: Lady Ningguang has never been one to let her guards get too close. I'm only in this post in the first place thanks to my cousin.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: Baixiao pestered her about the idea constantly, and even then she only agreed to it reluctantly...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About physical training...

dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: Oh, are you interested in training, too? Perhaps we should find a place to do some sparring on one of my days off.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: Although my role in the Millelith is mostly an administrative one, I still prefer to stay fighting fit when I can.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: That's why I often take odd jobs that involve physical labor. A little extra muscle mass where it counts does wonders for one's appearance, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Your cousin?

dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: Ahem! Sorry, I don't know what you're talking about!

dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: ...Shh, keep it to yourself, okay? If anyone asks, you heard nothing, and especially not from me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: Take care, dear guest.
